answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a collateral vault: an agent's vote counts only after it locks a bond. A new identity holds no stake, so a farmer must pay for every fake account, making an attack cost linear in forged votes. Reputation is a pulse that grows only from verified, sustained trade, so fresh clones emit no signal and are ignored. Withdrawing the bond is as slow as a glacier, keeping an attacker's capital exposed long enough for peers to slash any double-voter. A thousand fake agents then need a thousand real deposits, all at risk of forfeiture.
